title.fr_fr: Barre de combustible PWR HEA-242 appauvrie

content.en_us:

No direct recipe: ore, loot, assembled structure or by-product. See JEI (R key).

Used to make :
[[gv:nugget_zirconium|Zirconium Splinter]], [[Technetium|Technetium-99 Nugget]], [[gv:nuclear_waste_tiny|Tiny Pile of Nuclear Waste]].
